text: Security is an essential part of web development. When you build a website, you must protect both your users and your data. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt the connection between the browser and the server. Second, authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through passwords or two-factor methods. Third, input validation is important because it stops users from sending harmful data to your application. Developers should also learn about common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which can seriously damage a site. By paying attention to these areas, you can make your web applications much safer and more trustworthy.
